lines.narration: The loudest sound ever: an island that blew itself apart.
In eighteen eighty three, Krakatoa was an island near Java.
A hundred miles out, it rated about one hundred eighty decibels.
Pain kicks in around one hundred and thirty. This was fifty past it.
Forty miles out, over half a ship's crew had their eardrums burst.
Three thousand miles away, people blamed a nearby ship's cannons.
The pressure wave circled the entire planet. Three and a half times.
The waves it made killed thirty six thousand people.
And the island that made the sound was gone.
But Earth wasn't finished. A new island rose, the child of Krakatoa.
It's been growing for nearly a century, and it could do it all again.
